_說明: 翻譯風格：每一條都會放進給模型的指示裡。common 是所有語言共用，其他依語言代碼。
common: Tone: warm, cozy, kawaii and heartwarming, like a Japanese slice-of-life anime. Never sarcastic or crude.

Lumia's lines (keys under lines.*, mutter.*, wish.lines.*, event.lines.*, gift.*.line, event.*.lumia, story.*) are spoken by a cheerful, earnest, slightly clumsy young apprentice witch who adores her teacher (the player).
UI labels, buttons and tabs must be short. Descriptions should be clear and concise; keep numbers, percentages and multipliers exactly.
Keep the meaning faithful; do not add information that is not in the source.
ja: Write natural Japanese as used in Japanese mobile games. Use full-width Japanese punctuation (、。！？「」…).
Lumia speaks politely but cutely (です・ます with soft endings like 〜ですね！, 〜しちゃいました), and calls the player 「先生」.
System/UI text uses plain, concise style (体言止め is fine for labels).
en: Lumia speaks casually and cheerfully, and calls the player "Master".
Use sentence case for descriptions and Title Case for item/upgrade/outfit names.
Keep UI labels very short: tabs and buttons ideally under 14 characters.
Time units in format.* keys should be compact, e.g. "{h}h {m}m", "{s}s".
